(() => { const b=document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Increase temperature"]'); for(let i=0;i<12;i++) b.click(); return 'upper boundary driven'; })()

(() => { if(!document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Increase temperature"]').disabled || !document.querySelector('[data-readout]').textContent.startsWith('28°')) throw new Error('Upper limit failed'); const d=document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Decrease temperature"]'); for(let i=0;i<20;i++) d.click(); return 'upper limit pass'; })()

(() => { if(!document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Decrease temperature"]').disabled || !document.querySelector('[data-readout]').textContent.startsWith('16°')) throw new Error('Lower limit failed'); return 'lower limit pass'; })()

(() => { const el=document.querySelector('[class*=bars] span'); if(getComputedStyle(el).animationName !== 'none') throw new Error('Reduced motion did not stop'); if(document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth) throw new Error('Mobile overflow'); return 'reduced motion and mobile overflow pass'; })()
